pages.text: The Filters view offers a simple mode with filter slots and a whitelist or blacklist, and an advanced mode with an ordered rule list.$(br2)Each rule allows or denies matching units, can be limited to chosen targets, and can cap the amount per operation.

Rules use expressions:$(br)$(thing)minecraft:stone$() an id$(br)$(thing)#minecraft:logs$() a tag$(br)$(thing)@create$() a namespace$(br)$(thing)~sword$() part of a name$(br)$(thing)?enchanted$(br)?damaged$()$(br2)Combine with $(thing)& | !$() and brackets.
